title: OS National Geographic Database - Boundaries Collection in GeoParquet
description:
This is a trial version of Ordnance Survey's National Geographic Database Boundaries data in GeoParquet format intended for the purposes of standards development. 

This data is made available under the Open Government Licence 3.0 - https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3

Please be aware that this data will not be maintained.
